$comment: Bundle budgets, doc 20 §6. Single source consumed by
scripts/check-budgets.mjs; the table in doc 20 §6 must match it.
Limits are GZIPPED bytes unless the row says maxRawBytes.
Chunks are identified by the SOURCE MODULE that produced them, read
from the Vite/Rolldown client manifest — not by filename. SvelteKit
owns the emitted names and they are content hashes, so a name-matching
budget silently stops measuring the moment a hash changes.
Raising a number is a conscious decision that belongs in the same PR as

maplibre (vendored modules: main, shared, worker — on first map mount)
